name: Diorite Falls: Hike OR Bike
description:
Leader - Cherry Judge (Riding) + TBA walk Leader 

Rated: For the moderate level hiker and beginner to intermediate trail rider. 
This is an on-track walk and ride. Don't let the combo crew put you off.
It is an easy track though I'll say that you do need to have a good level of fitness as the uphill sections on the way back, while not technically difficult, has a continuous incline &  can go on for a bit and of course you have to consider time on feet / in saddle. So if you can keep up a moderate pace with the group [ walk OR ride] for about 3-4 hrs walking and about 2 hrs riding, then you should be fine. 

Tentative plan - 
Start from Paluma Dam.
The riders will obviously get to Diorite earlier, but you [rider] must be prepared to stay and swim or explore till the walkers are ready to head back to Dam.
Riding time - 1 hr to the falls and maybe a bit mroe on the way back because of the steepness.
Walking Time - 1.5 hrs there and 1.5 hrs back
At the falls - Riders - 1.5 hrs min [ we can explore around some of the creeks] - the pool makes for excellent swimming. Or bring a book and chill! 
At the Falls - Walkers - 1 hr. 
Post Walk- Ice cream at Frosty's

name: Lizard Gorge, Ollera Ck
description:
Leader: Ian Wallace
Rated: Moderate Fitness. Off track walk. 

Terrain: undulating, some creek based walking with loose and slippery rocks, steep sections, unmaintained overgrown track. Some high hills with viewpoints, some creek cascades and the swimming hole at Lizard Gorge.

The pace will be moderate and steady, so we can cover the distance within the designated time-frame and enjoy our stops at the points of interest.

Please read more about this walk on Wanderstories.space - https://wanderstories.space/ollera-creek/

What to expect:
-Many creek crossings and rock hopping in the creek bed
-The track is often not well-defined
-The terrain is undulating with some very steep sections
-Some overgrown sections, some gympie-gympie areas
-Heat, humidity, insects, extreme UV exposure
-Elevation change 180 metres
-Duration: approximately 8-9 hours including stops & breaks
 
Meeting Point and Time 
Meeting at 6:15 am. Need to RSVP and check with Ian. Details will be emailed. 

Duration: full day. We will aim to finish by 4-5 pm.
